tasks.label: build
tasks.command: mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/build" && nasm -f elf64 -g -F dwarf "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o" && ld -m elf_x86_64 "${workspaceFolder}/build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"
